items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: One of the trumpet players is the trumpet player on Saturday Night Live, Earl Gardner, great cat man.

ctx.x: So you’re still playing “Chicago” I guess.

Yeah, 25 years I’ve been playing it. So it’s still going. You know we closed for Covid for quite a while you know, like a year and a half. And then we went back, you know, they were trying to get New York going, there’s more people in New York now, you know, people are coming back. So it’s a good band, you know, it’s like a 13-piece band all good players, all great players you know. One of the trumpet players is the trumpet player on Saturday Night Live, Earl Gardner, great cat man. And anyway that’s what I’ve…
Ronnie, at what point does the band join, start rehearsing with the show? Where is the show at when you bring the band in?
